changelog: **Invitation funnel (#1921, slice 1):** `/admin/invitations` shows sent → opened → registered → signed in for the invitations sent in the board's date range, in total, per role and per inviter (`GET /api/admin/invitations/funnel`), and the report registry gains `invitation-funnel` (per role, privacy floor). Every step is an in-app event; "signed in" is read from `User.lastLoginAt` on the invitation's account in its own org. The rule is `src/lib/invitationFunnelRule.ts`. No schema change.

en: The invitation board now shows how many invitations were opened, turned into an account and led to a first sign-in — per role and per inviter.
tr: Davet panosu artık davetlerin kaçının açıldığını, hesaba dönüştüğünü ve ilk girişe ulaştığını gösteriyor; rol ve davet eden bazında.
de: Die Einladungsübersicht zeigt jetzt, wie viele Einladungen geöffnet wurden, zu einem Konto führten und mit einer ersten Anmeldung endeten – je Rolle und je einladender Person.
